upstream.description: nof1.ai Trading Bot is an open-source autonomous trading system built by Nof1.ai as part of the Alpha Arena experiment. It trades real crypto on Hyperliquid using deep reinforcement learning, live market signals, and adaptive AI-driven strategy optimization.

classification.analysis: An open-source autonomous crypto trading bot that connects to any LLM (GPT, DeepSeek, Qwen, Gemini, Grok, Claude) to trade on Hyperliquid, with a Streamlit-style GUI dashboard, multi-model 'collective intelligence' voting, risk management, and copy-trading features. Positioned as part of the 'Alpha Arena' experiment comparing different AI models' trading performance. Very low adoption (7 stars, 1 fork) and distributed as a Windows .exe loader rather than source-run instructions, which alongside inconsistent commit dates suggests an unverified, low-maturity side project.

use_cases.title: Run a local autonomous crypto trading bot
Compare multiple LLM trading strategies head to head
